payload.abstract: The neuroQWERTY MIT-CSXPD database contains keystroke logs collected from 85 subjects with and without parkinsons disease (PD). This dataset has been collected and analyzed in order to indicate that the routine interaction with computer keyboards can be used to detect motor signs in the early stages of PD.
